editorial:
You get a wild ride when an ancient queen wakes up in modern times and brings old curses with her. Tom Cruise plays a soldier who accidentally frees her, while Annabelle Wallis tries to stop the chaos. Russell Crowe adds a darker twist as a doctor with a secret. You follow them from desert tombs to London as the curse spreads. The movie mixes big action, creepy moments, and fast jokes, so it feels like a popcorn adventure more than a pure horror film.

The action scenes are loud and fun, and Sofia Boutella makes the villain memorable with sharp moves and a scary stare. Some jokes land, but the story can feel rushed and the tone jumps around a bit. If you want a simple thrill with monsters and stunts, you will have a good time. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or pick up the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture and sound.
endingExplained: In the final fight, Nick grabs the dagger meant for him and stabs himself, taking on Set's power. He uses that power to destroy Ahmanet, then brings Jenny back to life. Afterward, Nick leaves with his friend Vail, cursed and forever changed, promising to find a way to break the spell and protect other people from the new darkness ahead.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves big action, monsters, and easy weekend thrills.
